_comment: Inputs for build.py (graphite style, after Linear). accent: the same six accent colours as the rian-app-icon skill, tones = [light, main], aliases are other English names --accent takes; ui_primary is the UI primary each icon accent gives (蓝→蓝, 绿→绿, 紫→紫; warm 珊瑚 and 黄, and 灰, stay in the icon and give 蓝). base: the graphite neutral in CIE LCh (D65), one hue for every surface, chroma per mode (L 100 is plain white). ladder: L of each opaque neutral per mode. text: starting L of the four text tiers per contrast level; build.py only moves them toward more contrast until they pass (high-contrast text takes the end of the range as is). alpha: [base colour, opacity] per mode, where 'elevated' means that mode's elevated colour; menu_active is white over elevated in dark mode (light mode uses surface-3); frost_high replaces the frost opacity in the high-contrast schemes. primary: fill_target is the white-on-fill contrast the fill's L is chosen for, text_target what primary-text reaches on every surface (standard level; high contrast asks 7), selected and selection are the primary's opacity over bg for multi-selected rows and for text selection. status: which accent each status colour comes from (in-progress takes info, never warning). category: the app category (en is the icon skill's data-category; aliases also work) gives the icon accent, and through ui_primary the UI primary (AI 紫; 工具 蓝; 图片 黄 and 视频 珊瑚 stay in the icon and give 蓝; 健康 and 财务 绿); red is never the UI primary. media: the editor and viewer pages, dark in every scheme: canvas is the L of the four chroma-0 canvas steps (black, dark grey, mid grey, white), checker the two L of the transparency checkerboard, alpha [base colour, opacity] of the viewer scrim (its opaque end, the value the white controls are checked on), the edge under white handles, the white guides and the video scrubber's track (dim enough that its white played part stays 3:1 over a bright photo); scrim_stops are the viewer scrim gradient from the screen edge inward, [position, opacity]. brand: the app icon's own material, the same in every scheme, for brand surfaces only (onboarding and paywall hero, empty-state art, the about tile, launch screen, export-complete page): surface is the icon's graphite base top -> bottom (LCh L 16 -> 10, hue 265, chroma 2.5; rian-app-icon's default #bg) and body its light pieces (#body-fill); the brand accent is the icon's own accent from the accent table, never mapped. tile_radius is Apple's icon corner as a share of the side; mark sizes are the icon subject's height in pt (hero art, empty states; below mark_min use the app icon itself).
